WITH race_entry_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    raceId, 
    COUNT(*) as entry_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(points, 0)) as total_points
  FROM constructorResults
  GROUP BY raceId
),
avg_entries AS (
  SELECT AVG(entry_count) as avg_count
  FROM race_entry_counts
)
SELECT 
  r.raceId,
  c.country,
  rec.total_points,
  rec.entry_count,
  rec.entry_count - ae.avg_count as difference
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN race_entry_counts rec ON r.raceId = rec.raceId
CROSS JOIN avg_entries ae
WHERE rec.entry_count > ae.avg_count
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
